canonical_project: Otech (Oman Data Park) Firq / Nizwa data centre
owner: Otech (Omantel), Oman Data Park; solar integrated
notes: Otech official newsroom: 'upcoming' state-of-the-art data center in Firq, Nizwa (Ad Dakhiliyah/Interior), purpose-built with solar infrastructure, total power output 4.4 MW, 500+ racks. Otech launch page referenced Farq DC. Status planned/upcoming per official wording; DCD (2025) calls it planned with ~350 kW solar at launch. First solar-powered green DC initiative in Oman (AI in Oman).
